title: The basics: Your rights at work
content: The fact sheet says temporary visa holders, permanent residents and Australian citizens are covered by work health and safety laws that apply in Australia.
Workers should receive a workplace induction, equipment training, appropriate personal protective equipment, emergency procedures and information about reporting problems or injuries.
Workers can speak to a supervisor or health and safety representative about safety concerns and can contact SafeWork NSW on 13 10 50; the fact sheet says a translator may be requested.
The fact sheet says workers have the right to refuse unsafe work and should stop and speak with a supervisor or health and safety representative when work may be unsafe.
The fact sheet states workers compensation insurance can provide medical treatment and compensation for loss of income after an injury, subject to the applicable process.

SafeWork NSW states employers must provide a safe and healthy workplace, safe systems of work, adequate facilities, induction, training, supervision and an opportunity to discuss work health and safety.
